Components / Forms

Card number field

.dr-field__marks · .dr-paymark--fit · .dr-field__group · .dr-sr · components/form.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Visa or Mastercard
  1. 1.dr-field__inputThe number, inputmode="numeric", autocomplete="cc-number", described by the accepted brands. The screen opens it empty and gives it focus.
  2. 2.dr-field__marksThe marks at the row's trailing edge, 6 apart, aria-hidden.
  3. 3.dr-paymark--fitOne brand's artwork, viewBox cropped to the ink at 20 high: Visa 31 × 20, Mastercard 21 × 20. Full brand colour, a licensed exception to the palette.
  4. 4.sr-onlyVisa or Mastercard in words, because a logo is not an accessible name (WCAG 1.1.1).

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Card entry drawer (the card-number row).

States

Light

Dark

Try it: hover, press, Tab. Follows the theme switch above.

Visa or Mastercard

The empty row, from the Add card drawer on account-edit.

When to use

The card number field is the one field with a brand on it. It is the first row of account-edit's Add card drawer, above Expiry and CVV, opened from the payment method picker. The marks carry information there that no name beside them repeats, so they are hidden from assistive tech and the input is described by Visa or Mastercard in words. Only the two cards the product accepts are drawn.

The marks stand on one screen. account-edit builds the number row with them; payment, payment-aerial and payment-inspection build Card number as a plain field, filled, with no marks.

The labels are the plain names a card carries: Card number, Expiry, CVV. Each input takes its autocomplete token (cc-number, cc-exp, cc-csc, WCAG 1.3.5) and the CVV is masked.

Sources: DESIGN.md § The picker row (the third rung, .dr-paymark--fit) · ui/kit.html § Card number field · inventory.md § 1.5

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Visa or Mastercard

The Add card group on account-edit: the number row carries the marks, and the two rows under it are plain fields.

Don’t

Marks on a row that does not decide the brand. They belong on the number row only. A saved card is chosen, not typed, so it is a picker row whose options carry the 40 × 20 mark. A payment route is a row in the pay list.
